title: Blocks of Brawlgoofs
description: Adds goofy versions of some Brawl Stars characters as blocks
body:
- Adds goofy versions of some Brawl Stars characters as blocks.
- Add total of 13 new goofy blocks.
- This project isn't made seriously, it's just a joke to make some people laugh.
- Blocks are creative only.
- Idea by the Discord of the Melodie simps <3
